subject: Is the linked brush example app supposed to work currently?

messages.author: dea7fe9fc1920d2f
messages.subject: Is the linked brush example app supposed to work currently?
parts:
Dear ggvis team,

I have started to evaluate ggvis for a new project and I really like what I have seen and tried so far.

One thing I couldn't make work is the linked brush example app (ggvis / demo / apps / brush-linked /). Layer_brush() and brush_delay are gone. Thus I have modified the brush reactive from

  gv1 <- reactive({
    ggvis(diamonds, props(x = ~carat, y = ~price)) +
      mark_symbol(props(fill.brush := "red", fillOpacity := 0.8, key := ~id)) +
      layer_brush() +
      opts(width = 300, height = 300, brush_delay = 100)
  })

into

  gv1 <- reactive({
   lb <- linked_brush(keys = 1:nrow(diamonds))
    ggvis(diamonds, props(x = ~carat, y = ~price)) +
      mark_symbol(props(fill.brush := "red", fillOpacity := 0.8, key := ~id)) +
      lb$brush_handler() +
      opts(width = 300, height = 300)
  })

following the syntax from the linked_brush help. This makes the app load and to display the brush, but the brush does not seem to trigger any events. Is this supposed to work already?

Thanks a lot, and good luck with ggvis. It looks very promising already.

Thomas

messages.subject: Re: Is the linked brush example app supposed to work currently?
parts:
Hi Thomas -
Thanks for reporting this. The code for brushing has undergone a lot of changes since that example was written, and unfortunately it's broken right now. I just added it to the list of issues:
https://github.com/rstudio/ggvis/issues/111

messages.subject: Re: Is the linked brush example app supposed to work currently?
parts:
And it's fixed now :) The new LinkedBrush object makes this pretty
easy to express, but please note that the API is likely to continue to
change as we figure out how to express common/useful/important
operations more concisely.

Hadley
